one_sentence_story: In 2000 at UCL, Eleanor Maguire proved via structural MRI that licensed London black-cab drivers who spend 2–4 years memorizing 25,000 streets ('The Knowledge') develop physically larger posterior hippocampi scaling with years on the job — later proving against London bus drivers (2006) and before-and-after trainees (2011) that active mental mapping, not genetics or driving stress, caused the brain growth.
so_what_for_you: Don't live your life like a fixed-route bus on GPS autopilot: challenge your **posterior hippocampus** weekly by navigating neighborhood routes from memory, picturing landmarks on a mental overhead landmark map, and tackling genuinely Effortful cognitive puzzles at any age.
